actual_source_function.important_correction: FactorLinear is D(s_m) W D(r_m) with shared full W and private LayerNorm affine terms; the rank-one object is the Hadamard modifier s_m r_m^T. It is not a rank-one projector or generally a rank-one effective matrix. Actual unframed_f4 has no Householder frame.

decision: Retain exactly this architectural candidate for a theoretical/empirical test; reject universal fast-weight ordering-lock and novelty claims. Do not start fits or change current launched jobs from this packet.
direct_answer: No general same-ordering theorem follows from current fast weights. A specific sufficient-statistic collision forces identical scores in every route. Private structural interactions accessing topology outside that statistic can strictly overcome the collision while sharing one encoder.
embedding_diversity_assessment: Embedding orthogonality or pair-independent rotations are neither necessary nor sufficient for useful margin diversity. A compensated reparameterization can preserve all logits while changing embeddings; actual Hadamard-product scores are not invariant to arbitrary rotations, so do not claim all rotations are nuisance. The meaningful evidence is a changed score/margin function on the same pair identities, preserved competence and useful pooled correction. The regular uniform counterexample cannot be broken by any pair-independent coordinate transformation at all.

existing_evidence.critical_limit: Exact positive-versus-negative statistic collisions imply ties, not strict wrong margins. Therefore saved common STRICT wrong counts cannot themselves establish the exact collision mechanism. Approximate aliasing, shared nuisance cues, loss/calibration and training dynamics remain competing explanations.
existing_evidence.fixed_mean_barrier: If every member margin d_m(q,j)=f_m(q)-f_m(j)<0 for the same negative slot, mean_m d_m<0. With Kcommon strict negatives, rank_pool>=1+K and RR_pool<=1/(1+K). Elementary diagnostic algebra, not a new theorem.
existing_evidence.valid_inference: E has stronger mean members and a higher pool than J4 here, but less gain from pooling and more shared strict negative errors. J4 repairs some E common negatives, demonstrating real functional differences. These are descriptive three-block selected VALID associations, not a representation-cause diagnosis.

one_candidate.base: Keep the existing shared encoder and all current NCN/F4 base score paths. Add one residual per route; do not create private encoder copies, routers, learned member selection or an embedding-diversity loss.
one_candidate.complexity: Additional query-specific edge-intersection enumeration plus sum_e message cost andM private gate/readout costs. There is one shared graph encoder but no measured overall saving; dense CN subgraphs/high-degree queries can dominate.
one_candidate.correction_condition: For a base common wrong negative, pooled repair requires mean_m[res_m(q)-res_m(j)] > -mean_m d_base_m(q,j). Nonzero residual variance with zero mean cannot repair that pooled margin.

one_candidate.initialization: a_m=0 makes the extended score exactly equal to its base score at initialization. This is function-class inclusion, not competence retention during subsequent training.
one_candidate.name: Private pair-conditioned residuals over common-neighbor edges
one_candidate.no_general_competence_guarantee: Unrestricted residuals can hurt good base members and the pool. Structural gates can converge to the same function. Zero-init does not protect later rankings.
one_candidate.prior_position: Query-conditioned subgraphs/motifs are established SEAL/Neo-GNN/NCN-family territory; diagonal fast weights/private heads are established ensemble machinery. This candidate is an attributed structural-private composition and a precise hypothesis, not an established novel operator or theorem. Existing NCN2/completion/subgraph baselines must be considered before a novelty claim.
one_candidate.support_scope: All topology comes from the CURRENT target-masked support graph, with the same outer/inner/matched-random positive removal in every arm. Do not reinsert query labels/targets or use full unmasked TRAIN adjacency in the residual.
one_candidate.symmetries: Endpoint reversal and witness-edge reversal are invariant; node relabelling is equivariant if H is. No arbitrary positional node IDs.
one_candidate.trainable_roles: Backbone/base shared matrices and Psi weights are shared; existing base factors and new r_m,a_m are private. Psi is computed once per query/witness edge and reused across members; gates/readouts are private.
one_candidate.training_rule: Use the existing ordinary three-pass learning rule/loss/optimizer and raw arithmetic-mean serving, fixed before outcomes. No new contrastive penalty, live-credit meta rule, margin mining or loss/hyperparameter grid is part of this candidate.
one_candidate.what_is_new_relative_to_current_source: Private responses now weight query-conditioned interactions between common neighbors. The current route transforms each CN independently and discards induced adjacency; its factors cannot synthesize an unseen edge relation.
